description: List one namespace's functions — the name a script calls, its parameters, whether it only reads, whether it needs approval, and a snippet run_script accepts. crevioApi has hundreds of operations: narrow it with `search`.

namespace.description: A namespace from list_integrations, e.g. crevioApi or pdGmail.

offset.description: Skip this many matches — the count already seen.

search.description: Only functions whose name or description matches every word.

name: list_integration_tools

parameters.description: The argument object, as a TypeScript type.

requires_approval.description: A script cannot ask for approval, so calling it fails unless the account sets it to run automatically.

returns.description: What a read resolves to, as a TypeScript type; objects past two levels show as Record<string, unknown>.

snippet.description: A script run_script accepts as-is once the placeholders are filled.
